WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    r.ordervault,
    o.orderflow,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordervault,
    orderflow,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share
  FROM combination_counts
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    ordervault,
    orderflow,
    record_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  ordervault,
  orderflow,
  record_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_above_average
FROM compared
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY share_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
